findings.quote: Whatever the tray has caught stays on it, because the wind presses in at those joints.
findings.note: WORLD_KNOWLEDGE: cavity-tray/weep-hole building pathology decides it for a domain reader. Positive wind pressure on the face holds the tray's collected water back; the open perpends run only once the pressure differential goes, i.e. after the wind drops. A/B/C are all substantive positions in that same domain (A = naive 'wind forces it out', B = absorption-lag, C = missing-stop-end, a real and common defect), so the passage is still doing real work. No passage-free, domain-free mechanism delivers D.

findings.quote: The wind is still driving the rain into the brick, so little has reached the tray yet.
findings.note: Strip-the-absolutes re-run after the B rewrite: the tell no longer isolates anything. A ('Every joint ... is running') and C ('Nothing comes out') are hard universals; B is lexically hedged ('little ... yet') but D ('Whatever the tray has caught') is equally non-committal in force, so absoluteness splits 2-2. A crude 'pick the lexically hedged option' solver now lands on B, a distractor - the heuristic misfires rather than leaks. Repair verified effective.

findings.quote: Every joint above the opening is running, since the wind forces the water out through them.
findings.note: Residual soft narrowing, form-adjacent only: on direction the set is 3-1 (A = joints discharging vs B/C/D = little or nothing discharging), and B is the only option that never names the joints the stem asks about, so a test-wise solver can shed A and B and sit at C-vs-D 50/50. Deciding C vs D needs the stem presupposition ('before the wind drops' entails a wind-contingent state, which a missing stop end is not) - and that step requires knowing what a stop end is, i.e. domain, not form. Length is flat (91/86/87/86 chars, 16/17/16/16 words); longest-option points at A and misfires. Single-question sheet, so no cross-question corroboration channel exists.

findings.quote: Att bara en bråkdel av besparingen är påvisbar.
findings.note: PARTIALLY, best pick C. Chain: (1) D ('inte ... en enda krona') is the sole hard absolute and also the length outlier (34 chars vs 46-48), a visible throwaway; (2) A ('men först vid nästa upphandling', timing caveat) and B ('försiktigt och stegvis', pace caveat) are near-redundant 'yes, but not abruptly' stances that a test-wise reader distrusts as a mutually-cancelling pair - soft, since timing and manner are distinguishable in principle; (3) C is the hedged twin of D (same direction, weaker force) with a double hedge, quantitative ('bara en bråkdel') and epistemic ('påvisbar'), the classic key position. Better than chance, not decided by form alone.

findings.quote: Att den inte sparar en enda krona.
findings.note: Cross-question channel inside the sheet: q:2's four options are all about whether raising the limit would actually remove any tur, vehicle or stop, and no option anywhere in this sheet asserts that the saving is real - two q:1 options deny it, two dodge onto process. The sheet's own option composition therefore constrains the author's stance to savings-sceptical before any passage is read, which pushes the key into {C, D} and, with the absolutism tell on D, onto C. Passage-free and domain-free, but contingent enough on my own reading of q:1 to stay at major rather than lethal.

findings.quote: Antalet fordon som sätts in på morgonturerna styrs av hur många skjutsberättigade elever som stiger på.
findings.note: REPAIR VERIFIED: the old 4->1 method-derivability path is dead. Both rebuilt options now name predicates that laying pupil addresses over route timetables actually produces - B is a vehicle-allocation dependency readable off tur-by-tur boarding counts, D ('De flesta av hållplatserna ... trafikeras enbart för de berörda elevernas skull') is exactly what an address-on-stops overlay yields. Neither is a category error against the stated method any more, and both are substantive counter-positions to A (each implies the raise WOULD cut service, so the saving would be real). The previously named non-derivable predicates (cost-per-tur trend; municipal walkability judgement) do not appear anywhere in the current option set.

findings.quote: Nästan alla berörda elever åker med turer som ändå körs, och fordonen blir därför kvar.
findings.note: RESIDUAL BLIND FLOOR, best pick A. Pure form removes only C ('Ingen av de tjugotre ... skulle gå att korta', sole hard universal negative, also shortest at 73 chars) -> floor 1-in-3 over {A, B, D}. Direction is a clean 2-2 (A/C = no service removed, B/D = service driven by these pupils) so no cluster tell settles it; longest-option points at B (103 chars) and misfires; the conclusion-carrying tell also splits 2-2 (A and C both name the policy consequence, B and D are bare findings). Admitting the same cross-question channel flagged on q:1 - the sheet contains no 'the saving is real' stance anywhere - narrows to {A, C}, and the hedged twin ('Nästan alla') beats the absolute twin ('Ingen av de tjugotre'), landing on A. So the floor is 1-in-3 on form alone and a soft single pick once cross-question stance inference is allowed; every link is a prior rather than a mechanism, hence major not lethal.
